tiers.name: Luyện Khí
tiers.direction: humble novice: worn dark iron, plain wrapped wood, rough linen, simple leather; muted earth and sage; NO aura, NO glowing gems, NO royal crowns

tiers.name: Trúc Cơ
tiers.direction: refined foundation cultivator: polished steel, teal stitching, tiny jade fittings, sparse carved lines; faint single jade edge light, practical modest forms

tiers.name: Kim Đan
tiers.direction: golden-core adept: elegant silver and warm gold trims, amber gems, clear restrained cloud motifs; small warm golden halo, solid recognizable shapes

tiers.name: Nguyên Anh
tiers.direction: nascent-soul master: luminous white jade and indigo metal, sapphire inlays, flowing but compact designs, fine blue soul wisps; more regal than golden core

tiers.name: Hóa Thần
tiers.direction: spirit-transformation lord: radiant cyan and platinum, sculpted five-element marks, layered celestial armour with striking silhouette; contained cyan radiance

tiers.name: Luyện Hư
tiers.direction: void-refining sovereign: midnight violet and iridescent dark silver, carved hollow void rings, suspended inset gems, compact violet cosmic highlights; not spiky

tiers.name: Hợp Thể
tiers.direction: unity sovereign: emerald crystal and burnished celestial gold, integrated dragon-cloud motifs, substantial graceful forms, radiant green-gold core; powerful clean silhouettes

tiers.name: Đại Thừa
tiers.direction: ascendant sovereign: ivory, crimson-gold and pearlescent radiance, ornate but readable crowned armour, monumental divine motifs, small contained flame-like aura; near immortal

tiers.name: Chân Tiên
tiers.direction: true immortal final tier: luminous white, prismatic crystal and ancient gold, pure cosmic jade cores, supreme world-tree and starlight motifs, sculptural majestic artifacts, brightest controlled radiance, no excessive tendrils
